purpose: Generate falsifiable strategy hypotheses, not causal effects or selection claims
landmark_definition: First official pre-action observation in that month; features use only earlier actions
target: terminal quantitative score Q, including in-game eliminations
prediction_population: Games still active with a verified observation at the landmark; conditional discovery only
temporal_audit_amendment_before_fitting: State-only prediction uses fresh landmark states. Behaviour models require complete pre-landmark alignment. Later missing observations never exclude an earlier valid state. Compare model errors only on identical cohorts.
interpretation: Exploratory predictive associations; no p-value fishing or causal coefficient claims
continuation: Append immutable cycle directories and update the insight ledger; no background scheduler
